theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the strongest eligible theme on the trend-gate leg: it is eligible=true with the highest durability_bar (0.82) and a 'trend' hurst tag, suggesting it has the best staying-power under the one validated risk-control discipline. It ranks mid-table (5 of 17, score 0.555), so this is not a momentum-chase; it is a relative-preference among gate-eligible names for a trend-following, vol-aware tilt.
